questions.stem: Halvern City's permanent fund holds $3,000,000 of investments whose principal must be kept intact under a donor agreement; earnings fund park upkeep. In the government-wide statement of net position, the $3,000,000 is reported as:

choices.label: A
choices.text: Nonspendable net position

choices.label: B
choices.text: Unrestricted net position, with note disclosure

choices.label: C
choices.text: Restricted net position, displayed as nonexpendable

choices.label: D
choices.text: Net investment in capital assets

questions.explanation: Net position has only three components: net investment in capital assets, restricted, and unrestricted. A donor-imposed requirement to keep principal intact is an external restriction, so the amount is restricted net position; permanent endowment principal is shown as the nonexpendable portion of restricted net position. 'Nonspendable' is a GASB 54 fund balance classification used in governmental fund balance sheets, not a net position component. Unrestricted is wrong because the constraint is imposed by an external resource provider. Net investment in capital assets covers capital assets net of related debt, not investment securities.
questions.explanationJa: 純資産の区分は「資本資産への純投資」「拘束」「非拘束」の3つだけである。元本維持を求める寄付者の条件は外部からの拘束なので拘束純資産となり、永久基金の元本は拘束純資産のうち「非費消（nonexpendable）」部分として表示する。「Nonspendable」は GASB 54 の基金残高（基金の貸借対照表）の区分であり、純資産の区分ではない。外部の資源提供者による制約なので非拘束純資産は誤り。資本資産への純投資は資本資産から関連債務を差し引いたもので、投資有価証券は含まない。

questions.stem:
Corvale County reports the following obligations at year-end:
General obligation bonds (governmental activities) | $6,000,000
Revenue bonds of the water enterprise fund | $3,500,000
Net pension liability (governmental activities) | $2,200,000
Compensated absences (governmental activities) | $400,000
Bonds of a discretely presented component unit | $1,500,000
Special assessment debt; county not obligated in any manner | $800,000
What total long-term liabilities are reported in the primary government total column of the statement of net position?
questions.explanation: The primary government total column combines governmental and business-type activities: $6,000,000 GO bonds + $3,500,000 enterprise revenue bonds + $2,200,000 net pension liability + $400,000 compensated absences = $12,100,000. The $13,600,000 answer wrongly adds the discretely presented component unit's bonds, which belong in the separate component unit column. The $12,900,000 answer adds special assessment debt for which the county is not obligated in any manner; such debt is not a liability of the government. The $8,600,000 answer includes only governmental activities and omits the enterprise fund's revenue bonds.
questions.explanationJa: 主たる政府（primary government）の合計列は政府活動と事業型活動を合算する。一般財源債 $6,000,000＋水道事業基金の収入債 $3,500,000＋年金純負債 $2,200,000＋有給休暇債務 $400,000＝$12,100,000。$13,600,000 は個別表示の構成単位の債券を加えた誤りで、それは別列の構成単位列に表示する。$12,900,000 は郡が一切義務を負わない特別課徴金債務を加えた誤りで、これは政府の負債ではない。$8,600,000 は政府活動だけを集計し、事業基金の収入債を漏らしている。

questions.subtopic: Statement of Activities — Restricted Endowment Earnings
questions.stem: A city's permanent fund earns $90,000 of investment income that, under the trust terms, may be used only to operate the city library. In the government-wide statement of activities, the $90,000 is:

choices.label: A
choices.text: General revenue, as investment earnings

choices.label: B
choices.text: A direct addition to restricted net position

choices.label: C
choices.text: Permanent fund revenue eliminated on consolidation

choices.label: D
choices.text: Program revenue of the culture and recreation function

questions.explanation: Earnings on endowments or permanent fund investments are program revenues when they are restricted to a specific program; otherwise they are general revenues. Because these earnings may be used only for the library, they are program revenue of the function that houses the library (culture and recreation) and reduce that function's net expense. Reporting them as general investment earnings would apply only if the earnings were unrestricted. All revenues flow through the statement of activities; nothing bypasses it to go directly to net position. Revenues from external parties are not eliminated in the government-wide statements; only certain interfund activity is.
questions.explanationJa: 寄付基金（endowment）や永久基金の投資収益は、特定のプログラムに使途が拘束されていればプログラム収入、そうでなければ一般収入となる。本問の収益は図書館にしか使えないため、図書館を含む機能（文化・レクリエーション）のプログラム収入となり、その機能の純費用を減らす。一般収入の投資収益とするのは使途が拘束されていない場合だけである。収入はすべて活動計算書を通るので、純資産に直接加算されることはない。政府全体の財務諸表で消去されるのは一部の基金間取引だけで、外部からの収入は消去されない。

questions.stem: A county sold a large tract of undeveloped land at a $4,000,000 gain. The sale was within management's control and is unusual for the county. Under GASB 103, the gain is reported in the statement of activities:

choices.label: A
choices.text: As a special item, because it is within management's control

choices.label: B
choices.text: As an unusual or infrequent item, reported separately

choices.label: C
choices.text: As an extraordinary item, reported after special items

choices.label: D
choices.text: Within program revenues of the general government function

questions.explanation: GASB 103 eliminates the separate categories of special items and extraordinary items and replaces them with a single category, unusual or infrequent items. Whether the event is within management's control no longer determines the classification; it is only disclosed in the notes. Such items are reported separately as the last presented flows of resources before the change in net position. Classifying the gain as a special item (because it is within management's control) or as an extraordinary item reflects the superseded GASB 34 model. A gain on selling land is not program revenue of a function; it is not a charge for services or a program-specific grant.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 103 は特別項目（special items）と異常項目（extraordinary items）の区分を廃止し、「unusual or infrequent items」の一つに統合した。経営者の支配下にあるかどうかはもはや区分の基準ではなく、注記で開示するだけである。この項目は純資産の変動の直前に、最後のフローとして区分表示する。経営者の支配下にあるから特別項目とする、あるいは異常項目とするのは旧 GASB 34 の考え方である。土地売却益はサービス対価でも特定プログラム向け補助金でもないため、機能のプログラム収入にはならない。

questions.subtopic: Reconciliation — Pension Items to Net Position
questions.stem:
Bramford City's governmental funds report total fund balances of $6,000,000 at year-end. Governmental activities also have:
Capital assets, net of accumulated depreciation | $10,000,000
Net pension liability | $4,000,000
Deferred outflows of resources related to pensions | $900,000
Deferred inflows of resources related to pensions | $300,000
Outstanding encumbrances | $200,000
What is the net position of governmental activities?
questions.explanation: Start with total fund balances and add the economic-resource items that governmental funds do not report: $6,000,000 + $10,000,000 capital assets - $4,000,000 net pension liability + $900,000 deferred outflows - $300,000 deferred inflows = $12,600,000. Encumbrances are not liabilities and are already part of fund balance (committed or assigned), so they are not a reconciling item; adding them gives $12,800,000. The $11,400,000 answer reverses the signs of the deferred outflows and deferred inflows. The $16,000,000 answer ignores all pension-related items.
questions.explanationJa: 基金残高合計から出発し、政府基金では計上しない経済資源ベースの項目を加減する。$6,000,000＋資本資産 $10,000,000－年金純負債 $4,000,000＋繰延資源流出 $900,000－繰延資源流入 $300,000＝$12,600,000。エンカンブランスは負債ではなく既に基金残高（committed または assigned）に含まれているため調整項目ではない（加えると $12,800,000 になる）。$11,400,000 は繰延資源流出と流入の符号を逆にした誤り。$16,000,000 は年金関連項目をすべて無視した誤り。

questions.stem: Marlow Town's governmental funds report a net change in fund balances of $1,400,000. During the year, capital outlay expenditures were $900,000, depreciation on general capital assets was $350,000, and a resident donated land with an acquisition value of $600,000. What is the change in net position of governmental activities?
questions.explanation: $1,400,000 + $900,000 capital outlay (capitalized, not expensed) - $350,000 depreciation (an expense not recorded in the funds) + $600,000 donated land = $2,550,000. A donation of a capital asset provides no current financial resources, so governmental funds record nothing; the government-wide statements record the land at acquisition value and report capital contribution revenue, which increases net position. The $1,950,000 answer omits the donation. The $2,900,000 answer omits depreciation. The $1,350,000 answer subtracts the donation instead of adding it.
questions.explanationJa: $1,400,000＋資本的支出 $900,000（資産計上され費用ではない）－減価償却費 $350,000（基金では計上しない費用）＋寄贈土地 $600,000＝$2,550,000。資本資産の寄贈は流動財務資源をもたらさないため政府基金では何も記録しないが、政府全体では取得価額（acquisition value）で土地を計上し資本寄付収入を認識するので、純資産を増やす。$1,950,000 は寄贈を漏らした誤り、$2,900,000 は減価償却を漏らした誤り、$1,350,000 は寄贈を加算でなく減算した誤り。

questions.stem: Linford County has three discretely presented component units; one, a hospital authority, is major. Under GASB 103, which presentation of the hospital authority is acceptable?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Condensed financial statements in the notes to the financial statements

choices.label: B
choices.text: Inclusion only in the aggregated component units column

choices.label: C
choices.text: Blending into the business-type activities column

choices.label: D
choices.text: A separate column on the government-wide statements or a combining statement

questions.explanation: GASB 103 requires information about each major discretely presented component unit to be presented either in a separate column on the government-wide statements or in combining statements presented after the fund financial statements. The former option of presenting condensed financial statements in the notes is no longer permitted. Including the hospital only in the aggregated column provides no major-unit detail, which is required. Blending is used only when the blending criteria are met; a discretely presented component unit is by definition not blended into the primary government's columns.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 103 では、主要な（major）個別表示構成単位の情報は、政府全体の財務諸表上の別列か、基金財務諸表の後に置く結合計算書（combining statements）のいずれかで表示しなければならない。従来認められていた注記での要約財務諸表の開示は認められなくなった。集約された構成単位列に含めるだけでは主要単位ごとの詳細が示されず要件を満たさない。合算表示（blending）は合算の要件を満たす場合に限られ、個別表示の構成単位を主たる政府の列に合算することはない。

questions.stem: Ridgeport City is the sole corporate member of Ridgeport Parking Corporation, a legally separate not-for-profit corporation that is a component unit of the city under the financial accountability criteria. How should the city report it?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Discretely, in a separate component units column

choices.label: B
choices.text: Blended, as though it were part of the primary government

choices.label: C
choices.text: As a private-purpose trust fund in the fiduciary statements

choices.label: D
choices.text: Excluded, with disclosure in the notes only

questions.explanation: A component unit incorporated as a not-for-profit corporation in which the primary government is the sole corporate member is blended, so its balances and transactions are reported as if they were part of the primary government. Discrete presentation is the default for component units that do not meet a blending criterion, but sole corporate membership is itself a blending criterion. Fiduciary funds report resources held for others, not an entity the city controls and operates. The corporation meets the financial accountability criteria, so it must be included in the reporting entity rather than only disclosed.
questions.explanationJa: 主たる政府が唯一の法人会員（sole corporate member）である非営利法人の構成単位は合算表示（blended）とし、主たる政府の一部であるかのように報告する。合算の要件を満たさない構成単位は個別表示が原則だが、唯一の法人会員であることはそれ自体が合算の要件である。受託者基金は他者のために保有する資源を報告するもので、市が支配・運営する事業体を報告する場所ではない。財務的説明責任の要件を満たすため、注記開示だけで済ませず報告主体に含める必要がある。

questions.stem: Easton City's general fund paid the water enterprise fund $400,000 for water used in city buildings at standard rates. In the government-wide statement of activities, this is:

choices.label: A
choices.text: Eliminated, because it occurs between funds of one government

choices.label: B
choices.text: Reported as a transfer between the two activity types

choices.label: C
choices.text: Reported as function expenses and business-type charges for services

choices.label: D
choices.text: Reported as general revenue of the business-type activities

questions.explanation: Interfund services provided and used, such as water sold at standard rates, are not eliminated in the statement of activities, because eliminating them would misstate the expenses of the buying functions and the program revenues of the selling activity. The governmental functions report $400,000 of expenses and the water activity reports $400,000 of charges for services. Elimination applies to internal balances and to transfers within the same activity type, not to interfund services. A transfer is a flow without equivalent exchange; this is an exchange at standard rates. Charges for services are program revenue, not general revenue.
questions.explanationJa: 通常料金での水道料金のような基金間のサービス提供・利用（interfund services provided and used）は、活動計算書で消去しない。消去すると購入側の機能の費用と販売側の活動のプログラム収入が過小になるからである。政府活動の各機能が費用 $400,000、水道事業がサービス対価収入 $400,000 を計上する。消去されるのは内部残高や同じ活動区分内の振替であり、基金間サービスは対象外。振替（transfer）は対価のない資源移転で、本問は通常料金での交換取引である。サービス対価はプログラム収入であり一般収入ではない。

questions.stem: A state constitution requires that all motor fuel tax collections be used only for highway maintenance. In the state's governmental fund balance sheet, unspent motor fuel tax resources are classified as:

choices.label: A
choices.text: Restricted fund balance

choices.label: B
choices.text: Committed fund balance

choices.label: C
choices.text: Assigned fund balance

choices.label: D
choices.text: Nonspendable fund balance

questions.explanation: Restricted fund balance includes amounts constrained by external parties or imposed by law through constitutional provisions or enabling legislation. A constitutional requirement therefore produces restricted fund balance. Committed fund balance results from formal action of the government's own highest level of decision-making authority (such as the legislature passing an ordinance or resolution it can later rescind), which is a self-imposed limit, not a constitutional one. Assigned fund balance reflects intended use by a body or official with delegated authority. Nonspendable covers amounts not in spendable form (inventory, prepaids) or legally required to be kept intact; cash collections are spendable.
questions.explanationJa: 拘束（restricted）基金残高には、外部者による制約、または憲法の規定や授権立法により法的に課された制約を受ける金額が含まれる。したがって憲法上の要件は restricted になる。committed は政府自身の最高意思決定機関の正式な行為（後で撤回できる条例・決議など）による自己拘束であり、憲法による制約とは異なる。assigned は権限委譲を受けた機関や職員による使途の意図を表す。nonspendable は換金できない形態（棚卸資産・前払費用）や元本維持が法的に求められる金額であり、現金の税収は支出可能な形態である。

questions.stem:
At year-end, Pellham City's general fund reports the following:
Prepaid insurance | $50,000
Stabilization amount set aside by council ordinance | $1,000,000
Encumbrances for supplies, from unrestricted resources | $150,000
Fund balance the finance director (under delegated authority) appropriated to close next year's budget gap | $400,000
What amount should be reported as assigned fund balance?
questions.explanation: Assigned fund balance = $150,000 encumbrances funded from unrestricted, uncommitted resources + $400,000 of existing fund balance appropriated to eliminate a projected deficit in the next year's budget = $550,000. Both reflect an intended use that is not a formal constraint of the highest decision-making authority. The council ordinance creates committed fund balance, so including it gives $1,550,000. Prepaid insurance is nonspendable, so including it gives $600,000. The $400,000 answer omits the encumbrances; encumbrances are not a separate fund balance category and are reported within assigned (or committed/restricted) based on the resources used.
questions.explanationJa: assigned 基金残高＝拘束・コミットされていない財源によるエンカンブランス $150,000＋翌年度予算の見込み赤字を埋めるために充当した既存の基金残高 $400,000＝$550,000。いずれも最高意思決定機関の正式な制約ではない「使途の意図」である。議会の条例による積立は committed なので、含めると $1,550,000 になる。前払保険料は nonspendable なので、含めると $600,000 になる。$400,000 はエンカンブランスを漏らした誤り。エンカンブランスは独立した基金残高区分ではなく、使う財源に応じて assigned（または committed/restricted）に含める。

questions.stem: A $900,000 court judgment against Carver City became final in Year 2. The city paid $300,000 in Year 2; the remaining $600,000 is due in Year 4. What general fund expenditure and government-wide expense are reported for Year 2?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Expenditure $900,000; expense $900,000

choices.label: B
choices.text: Expenditure $300,000; expense $900,000

choices.label: C
choices.text: Expenditure $300,000; expense $300,000

choices.label: D
choices.text: Expenditure $0; expense $900,000

questions.explanation: Under modified accrual, claims and judgments are recognized as expenditures only to the extent they are paid or have matured (are due and payable) and will be liquidated with current financial resources. Only $300,000 was paid, and the remaining $600,000 is not due until Year 4, so the general fund expenditure is $300,000. Under accrual accounting in the government-wide statements, the full $900,000 liability is recognized as an expense when the judgment becomes final. Recognizing $900,000 in the fund ignores the current financial resources focus; recognizing only $300,000 in both ignores accrual accounting; $0 ignores the amount actually paid.
questions.explanationJa: 修正発生主義では、訴訟・判決債務は支払済みまたは期日到来分（流動財務資源で決済されるもの）だけを支出として認識する。支払ったのは $300,000 で残り $600,000 は Year 4 まで期日が来ないため、一般基金の支出は $300,000。政府全体の発生主義では、判決確定時に $900,000 全額の負債と費用を認識する。基金で $900,000 とするのは流動財務資源の測定焦点を無視しており、両方 $300,000 とするのは発生主義を無視している。$0 は実際の支払額を無視している。

questions.stem: In Year 1, Dunmore County received an $800,000 cash gift from a foundation, restricted to buying library books with no time requirement; $500,000 was spent by year-end. It also has a $600,000 state reimbursement grant and incurred $450,000 of allowable costs under it. What nonexchange revenue should be recognized in the Year 1 government-wide statements?
questions.explanation: The foundation gift has only a purpose restriction; purpose restrictions do not delay revenue recognition, so all $800,000 is revenue in Year 1 (with the unspent portion reported as restricted net position). For a reimbursement grant, the eligibility requirement is met only as allowable costs are incurred, so $450,000 is recognized. Total = $800,000 + $450,000 = $1,250,000. The $950,000 answer limits the gift to the amount spent, treating a purpose restriction as an eligibility requirement. The $1,400,000 answer recognizes the full grant award. The $1,100,000 answer limits the gift to the $500,000 spent and also recognizes the full $600,000 grant award.
questions.explanationJa: 財団からの寄付は使途（目的）制限だけで、目的制限は収入認識を遅らせないため、$800,000 全額を Year 1 の収入とする（未使用分は拘束純資産）。償還型補助金は対象経費の発生時に適格要件が満たされるので $450,000 を認識する。合計 $800,000＋$450,000＝$1,250,000。$950,000 は目的制限を適格要件と取り違え、寄付を支出額に限定した誤り。$1,400,000 は補助金の交付決定額全額を計上した誤り。$1,100,000 は寄付を支出額 $500,000 に限定し、かつ補助金を交付決定額 $600,000 全額で計上した誤り。

questions.subtopic: Interfund Loan Not Expected to Be Repaid
questions.stem: In Year 1, Westfield City's general fund lent $600,000 to a special revenue fund. In Year 3, the council determined that $200,000 will never be repaid. How is the $200,000 reported in Year 3?

choices.label: A
choices.text: As general fund expenditure and special revenue fund revenue

choices.label: B
choices.text: As bad debt expense in the general fund

choices.label: C
choices.text: As a transfer from the general fund to the special revenue fund

choices.label: D
choices.text: As an interfund receivable with an allowance for uncollectibles

questions.explanation: When repayment of an interfund loan is not expected within a reasonable time, the interfund balances are reduced and the amount not expected to be repaid is reported as a transfer from the lending fund to the borrowing fund. The general fund reports a $200,000 transfer out and the special revenue fund a transfer in, both as other financing sources (uses). Reporting expenditure and revenue would treat an internal flow as if it were with an external party. Bad debt expense and an allowance are not used for interfund balances, which are eliminated or reclassified rather than written down.
questions.explanationJa: 基金間貸付の返済が合理的な期間内に見込まれなくなった場合、基金間残高を減額し、返済されない金額を貸付側から借入側への振替（transfer）として報告する。一般基金は $200,000 の transfer out、特別収入基金は transfer in を、いずれもその他の財源（使途）として計上する。支出と収入で処理すると、内部の資源移動を外部取引のように扱うことになる。基金間残高に貸倒費用や貸倒引当金は使わず、評価減ではなく振替への組替えで処理する。

questions.stem: Under GASB 103, which statement about budgetary comparison information for a city's general fund is correct?

choices.label: A
choices.text: It may be presented as a basic financial statement or as RSI

choices.label: B
choices.text: Only final budget and actual amounts must be shown

choices.label: C
choices.text: Actual amounts must be presented on the GAAP basis

choices.label: D
choices.text: It is RSI and shows original-to-final and final-to-actual variances

questions.explanation: GASB 103 requires budgetary comparison information to be presented as required supplementary information; the former option of presenting it as a basic financial statement is removed. The comparison includes the original budget, the final budget, and actual amounts, together with variances between the original and final budgets and between the final budget and actual amounts. Showing only the final budget and actual omits required content. Actual amounts are presented on the budgetary basis so they can be compared with the budget, with differences from GAAP explained.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 103 は予算比較情報を必要補足情報（RSI）として表示することを求め、基本財務諸表として表示する選択肢を廃止した。比較には当初予算・最終予算・実績を含め、当初予算と最終予算の差異、最終予算と実績の差異を示す。最終予算と実績だけでは必要な内容が欠ける。実績は予算と比較できるよう予算基準で表示し、GAAP との差異は説明する。

questions.subtopic: Proprietary Fund Cash Flows — Four Categories
questions.stem: Which cash flow of a city's sewer enterprise fund is a noncapital financing activity in its statement of cash flows?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Interest paid on revenue bonds issued to build a treatment plant

choices.label: B
choices.text: Interest paid on a short-term note used to fund operating payroll

choices.label: C
choices.text: Interest received on investments in Treasury securities

choices.label: D
choices.text: Cash paid to suppliers for treatment chemicals

questions.explanation: A proprietary fund statement of cash flows has four categories: operating, noncapital financing, capital and related financing, and investing. Borrowing for operating purposes, and the interest paid on that borrowing, is noncapital financing. Interest on debt issued to acquire or construct capital assets is a capital and related financing activity. Interest and dividends received on investments are investing activities, unlike the FASB model that classifies them as operating. Payments to suppliers for goods used in operations are operating activities.
questions.explanationJa: proprietary fund のキャッシュフロー計算書は、営業活動・非資本的財務活動・資本的および関連財務活動・投資活動の4区分である。運転資金のための借入とその支払利息は非資本的財務活動。資本資産の取得・建設のために発行した債務の利息は資本的および関連財務活動。投資の受取利息・配当は投資活動（FASB では営業活動になる点と異なる）。営業に使う物品の仕入先への支払は営業活動。

questions.stem: Grayson County collects vehicle registration fees for the state and remits them within 30 days. In its custodial fund's statement of changes in fiduciary net position, the county may:

choices.label: A
choices.text: Report a single aggregated total for additions and one for deductions

choices.label: B
choices.text: Omit the fees and report only year-end balances

choices.label: C
choices.text: Report the fees as charges for services of general government

choices.label: D
choices.text: Report the fees as deferred inflows until they are remitted

questions.explanation: Under GASB 84, a fiduciary fund may report a single aggregated total for additions and a single aggregated total for deductions when the resources, upon receipt, are normally expected to be held for three months or less. Fees remitted within 30 days qualify. Custodial funds still present a statement of changes in fiduciary net position, so the flows cannot simply be omitted. The fees belong to the state, so they are not program revenue of the county's general government function. Deferred inflows relate to resources applicable to a future period, not to amounts held for another government.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 84 では、受領時点で通常3か月以内しか保有しない資源については、受託者基金は増加（additions）と減少（deductions）をそれぞれ1行の合計額で報告できる。30日以内に送金する手数料はこれに該当する。カストディアル基金も受託者純資産変動計算書を作成するため、フローを省略することはできない。手数料は州のものであり、郡の一般行政機能のプログラム収入ではない。繰延資源流入は将来期間に帰属する資源であり、他の政府のために保有する金額には使わない。

questions.subtopic: Proprietary Fund Operating Statement — Noncapital Subsidies (GASB 103)
questions.stem: Kelton City's transit enterprise fund receives a $1,200,000 federal grant to help cover bus operating costs (no capital purpose); the grant keeps fares lower than they would otherwise be and the fund provides no goods or services to the grantor. Under GASB 103, how is the grant displayed in the fund's operating statement?

choices.label: A
choices.text: As operating revenue, since it finances day-to-day operations

choices.label: B
choices.text: As a capital contribution, after nonoperating revenues and expenses

choices.label: C
choices.text: As a noncapital subsidy, presented directly after operating income (loss)

choices.label: D
choices.text: As a special item, the last line before net position

questions.explanation: GASB 103 defines operating revenues and expenses as those other than nonoperating items, and subsidies received are nonoperating. A subsidy is a resource received from another party for which the fund provides no goods or services and that directly or indirectly keeps the fund's fees and charges lower than they would otherwise be, which describes this grant. Noncapital subsidies are reported separately immediately after operating income (loss), producing a subtotal of operating income (loss) and noncapital subsidies, before other nonoperating revenues and expenses. Treating the grant as operating revenue overstates operating results; financing day-to-day costs does not make a subsidy operating. Capital contributions relate to capital assets, and this grant has no capital purpose. Special items no longer exist under GASB 103.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 103 は営業収益・費用を非営業項目以外のものと定義し、受け取った補助（subsidies）は非営業項目とする。補助とは、他者から受け取る資源で、基金が見返りの財・サービスを提供せず、かつ料金を本来より低く抑える効果があるものをいい、本問の補助金はこれに当たる。非資本的補助は営業利益（損失）の直後に区分表示し、「営業利益（損失）および非資本的補助」の小計を設けたうえで、その他の非営業収益・費用を続ける。営業収益とすると営業成績が過大になり、日常経費を賄う目的でも補助は営業項目にならない。資本拠出は資本資産に関するもので、本補助金は資本目的を持たない。特別項目は GASB 103 で廃止された区分である。
